title: Natural-degree scalar external Cech cup compatibility
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $F,G$ quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent], and $U,V$ arbitrary open covers. Let $A,B$ be their scalar Cech complexes and $P$ the scalar Cech complex for $F\boxtimes G$ on the product cover [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models, def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Suppose $c:\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_kB)\to P$ satisfies the external front/back coordinates [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-component]. Let $e_X,e_Y,e_P$ be degreewise $k$-linear maps to scalar cohomology satisfying IsPicardScalarCechComparison [lem-sc-picard-scalar-cech-comparison]. For $p+q=n$, factor cycles $a,v$, and a total cycle $z$ whose inclusion is the $(p,q)$-summand inclusion of the tensor of their inclusions, $e_P(H^n(c)([z]))$ is externalCup of $e_X([a])$ and $e_Y([v])$, transported along $p+q=n$. No affine assumptions, existence of comparisons, their invertibility, fixed resolution model or extension to integers enter this assertion.

proof.text: Refine the two projection-pulled-back factor covers to the product cover using its two index projections. The prescribed c coordinates on the specified tensor cycle equal the front/back cup of the two refinement images, by their adjunction-unit formulas. Restriction composition identifies the opens. Monicity of cycle inclusions identifies the resulting cycles.

Use the witnesses in IsPicardScalarCechComparison to replace eX, eY and eP by their canonical module comparisons through the explicit additive identifications. Apply the refinement/pullback comparison squares to the two factors and the Cech/sheaf cup comparison on the product. Thus the compared image is the sheaf cup of the two pulled-back classes.

Identify this class with the scalar Ext formula: represent a module cohomology class by a cocycle in an injective resolution, and represent the corresponding Ext class by the unit-module morphism evaluated at 1. The characterization of moduleExtEquiv identifies these classes. Exact scalar restriction carries the same morphisms and their cocycle equations to k-sheaves. The scalar pullback coefficient has adjoint equal to the tensor-pullback unit, and the scalar tensor coefficient sends a pure tensor of sections to tmulSection. Consequently the pullback and tensor pairings of these representatives compute exactly scalarCohomologyPullback followed by scalarCohomologyCup, which defines externalCup. Pass to homology and transport the degree p+q=n. Empty covers and zero coefficients give zero classes, and degree zero is the section tensor pairing.

theorem picardScalarCech_externalCup
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤)
    (c : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F)
        ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶
      (picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hc : IsPicardExternalCechCupComponent f g U V F G c)
    (eX : ∀ p : ℕ, ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).homology p →ₗ[k]
      scalarCohomology f F p)
    (heX : ∀ p, IsPicardScalarCechComparison f U F p (eX p))
    (eY : ∀ q : ℕ, ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).homology q →ₗ[k]
      scalarCohomology g G q)
    (heY : ∀ q, IsPicardScalarCechComparison g V G q (eY q))
    (eP : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology n →ₗ[k]
        scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n)
    (heP : ∀ n, IsPicardScalarCechComparison (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
        pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n (eP n)) :
    let A := (picardCechFunctor f U).obj F
    let B := (picardCechFunctor g V).obj G
    let T := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
      (a : A.cycles i.val.1) (v : B.cycles i.val.2) (z : T.cycles n),
      T.iCycles n z =
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) i.val.1 i.val.2 n i.property
            ((A.iCycles i.val.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles i.val.2 v)) →
      eP n (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c n (T.homologyπ n z)) =
        cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property)
          (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2
            (eX i.val.1 (A.homologyπ _ a)) (eY i.val.2 (B.homologyπ _ v)))
